rfaq1.question: How do I submit my monthly rent payment?
rfaq1.answer: Open Payments and select Pay Rent Now. Choose MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money, or Bank Transfer, enter your transaction reference or upload your confirmation screenshot, and submit.

rfaq2.question: Where can I download my rent payment receipts?
rfaq2.answer: All confirmed payment receipts appear automatically on both the Payments page (View Receipt) and the Documents page.

rfaq3.question: How do I review or sign my lease agreement?
rfaq3.answer: Go to Lease to inspect your lease terms, due date, security deposit, and open the full lease agreement document. You can preview, download, or sign pending agreements directly.

rfaq4.question: How do I report a maintenance problem in my apartment?
rfaq4.answer: Visit Maintenance and click Report New Issue. Provide a clear title, category, priority, and description so your landlord can schedule repairs.

rfaq5.question: What happens if my landlord logs a rental obligation notice?
rfaq5.answer: You receive a 3-day notice window before any obligation can be confirmed. In Rental History, you can either settle the balance or submit a dispute with payment proof for review.

rfaq6.question: Can I browse new homes and request viewings as a renter?
rfaq6.answer: Yes. Use Explore Homes to search available listings by district, budget, and bedrooms, message landlords with inquiries, and book viewing visits.
